schemes.title: SemTS Data Knowledge Vocabulary
schemes.description: A stable, domain-neutral SKOS core for knowledge derived from time-series data. Concrete feature concepts are structurally separated into a default-imported feature extension.
schemes.scopeNote: The core contains stable result categories, prediction meanings, relation meanings, model artifacts, representation results, and decomposition components. It does not duplicate concrete features declared in the imported feature extension.
schemes.editorialNote: Concept IRIs published in version 1.2.0 of this vocabulary keep their semts-dv IRIs, including the concrete features that moved to the feature extension. Concepts added after 1.2.0 to the extension use the semts-dfx namespace.

schemes.title: SemTS Data Feature Catalogue Extension
schemes.description: Default-imported extension containing concrete time-series feature meanings, including general summary features and tsfresh-aligned feature calculators. Stable semantic families remain in the Data Knowledge core. The catalogue is an example of a feature extension, aligned with one feature library. It is neither complete nor normative, and further feature catalogues can extend the core in the same way.
schemes.scopeNote: The extension is structurally separate but included by default through owl:imports from the Data Knowledge core. Feature concepts are not duplicated in the core file.
schemes.editorialNote: Namespace policy: features published in version 1.2.0 of the Data Knowledge vocabulary keep their semts-dv IRIs so that existing data stays valid. Features added later use the semts-dfx namespace of this extension.

schemes.title: SemTS Scenario Knowledge Vocabulary
schemes.description: A domain-neutral SKOS vocabulary for scenario knowledge associated directly or indirectly with time-series data, including annotations, contextual descriptions, events, parameters, and relation meanings. Domain extensions add only genuinely narrower concepts.
schemes.scopeNote: The active core avoids domain-qualified variants when a generic concept is sufficient. For example, Cycle Start and Cycle Complete are domain-neutral. A domain extension should add a narrower term only when it contributes additional meaning beyond a prefix or suffix.

schemes.title: SemTS Manufacturing Scenario Knowledge Extension
schemes.description: A minimal example extension of the SemTS Scenario Knowledge vocabulary for genuinely manufacturing-specific meanings. Generic operational concepts remain in the scenario core. The module illustrates how a domain extends a core vocabulary. It is not a complete manufacturing vocabulary, and other domains are expected to publish their own extensions in the same way.
schemes.scopeNote: The extension is not intended to be populated exhaustively. Terms are added only when a manufacturing-specific specialization contributes semantics beyond merely adding “manufacturing”, “production”, or a similar qualifier to a generic core concept.
schemes.editorialNote: The deprecated scenario concepts Production Cycle Start, Production Cycle Complete and Tool Wear State are declared in the Scenario Knowledge core, because their IRIs belong to that namespace.

schemes.title: SemTS Knowledge Generation Vocabulary
schemes.description: A domain-neutral SKOS vocabulary for classifying methods, comparisons, reasoning activities, and human processes that generate knowledge associated with time-series data, and for method knowledge: knowledge about which generation methods and settings work for which data. Detailed machine-learning concepts are referenced from the Machine Learning Sailor Taxonomies (MLST).
schemes.scopeNote: The hierarchy remains shallow and method-oriented. Feature extraction, feature selection, and representation learning are sibling feature-engineering activities. Concrete software algorithms remain external taxonomy concepts.
schemes.editorialNote: The scheme has two top concepts. Concepts under Knowledge Generation are semts:KnowledgeGenerationConcept and classify knowledge generation entities (semts:knowledgeGenerationConcept). Concepts under Method Knowledge are semts:KnowledgeConcept and classify semts:MethodKnowledge, semts:Algorithm and semts:Hyperparameter instances (semts:knowledgeConcept).

schemes.title: SemTS Knowledge Quality Measure Vocabulary
schemes.description: A domain-neutral SKOS vocabulary for quality dimensions, relational measures, and a deliberately small set of widely used evaluation metrics relevant to time-series analysis.
schemes.scopeNote: Concrete metrics are limited to broadly established forecasting, classification, clustering, similarity, distance, and correlation measures. More specialized measures should be referenced from MLST or supplied through extensions.

semts-dv:Anomaly.label: Anomaly
semts-dv:Anomaly.def: Knowledge asserting that a data point, interval, segment, or group deviates from an expected reference or pattern.

semts-dv:AssociationRule.label: Association Rule
semts-dv:AssociationRule.def: A conditional association between patterns, events, states, or knowledge propositions.
semts-dv:AssociationRule.scope: When represented as a directed relation, source is the antecedent and target is the consequent.

semts-dv:CausalGraph.label: Causal Graph
semts-dv:CausalGraph.def: Network representation of causal relationships between time series variables.

semts-dv:CausalInfluence.label: Causal Influence
semts-dv:CausalInfluence.def: A directional influence whose intervention or change can affect a target.

semts-dv:CauseEffectDependency.label: Cause-Effect Dependency
semts-dv:CauseEffectDependency.def: A causal dependency in which a source contributes to or determines an effect at a target.
semts-dv:CauseEffectDependency.scope: Source is represented as a cause of, or causal contributor to, target.

semts-dv:ChangeProperty.label: Change Property
semts-dv:ChangeProperty.def: A characteristic describing increments, differences, variation, or change intensity over time.

semts-dv:ClassMembership.label: Class Membership
semts-dv:ClassMembership.def: A class or category membership assigned to a segment or knowledge item.

semts-dv:Classification.label: Classification Result
semts-dv:Classification.def: Knowledge assigning one or more class labels to a segment, dimension, or group of segments.

semts-dv:ClusterMembership.label: Cluster Membership
semts-dv:ClusterMembership.def: Membership of a segment or knowledge item in a cluster.

semts-dv:Clustering.label: Clustering Result
semts-dv:Clustering.def: Knowledge describing a grouping of segments or observations obtained by a clustering method.

semts-dv:Coherence.label: Coherence
semts-dv:Coherence.def: Frequency-specific correlation measure between time series indicating synchronized behavior.

semts-dv:ComplexityProperty.label: Complexity Property
semts-dv:ComplexityProperty.def: A characteristic describing regularity, entropy, compressibility, or dynamical complexity.

semts-dv:ConceptDrift.label: Concept Drift
semts-dv:ConceptDrift.def: Change in the underlying data-generating process affecting model performance over time.

semts-dv:ConfidenceInterval.label: Confidence Interval
semts-dv:ConfidenceInterval.def: Statistical interval around point forecasts indicating parameter uncertainty.

semts-dv:CounterfactualPrediction.label: Counterfactual Prediction
semts-dv:CounterfactualPrediction.def: Predicted outcomes under hypothetical scenarios that did not actually occur.

semts-dv:CrossSpectralDensity.label: Cross-Spectral Density
semts-dv:CrossSpectralDensity.def: Frequency domain representation of relationships between multiple time series.

semts-dv:CyclicalComponent.label: Cyclical Component
semts-dv:CyclicalComponent.def: Longer-term cyclical patterns distinct from regular seasonality.

semts-dv:DTWDistance.label: DTW Distance
semts-dv:DTWDistance.def: Dynamic Time Warping distance between sequences.

semts-dv:DataInformationProperty.label: Data Information Property
semts-dv:DataInformationProperty.def: General informational attributes of data segments.

semts-dv:DetectedEvent.label: Detected Event
semts-dv:DetectedEvent.def: An event occurrence inferred from time-series data.

semts-dv:DirectCausalEffect.label: Direct Causal Effect
semts-dv:DirectCausalEffect.def: A causal effect not mediated by another represented cause-effect step.
semts-dv:DirectCausalEffect.scope: Source has a direct causal effect on target.

semts-dv:DispersionProperty.label: Dispersion Property
semts-dv:DispersionProperty.def: Measures of the spread or variability within data segments.

semts-dv:DistributionShapeProperty.label: Distribution Shape Property
semts-dv:DistributionShapeProperty.def: A characteristic describing the shape of the value distribution.

semts-dv:Embedding.label: Embedding
semts-dv:Embedding.def: A vector or structured representation of a segment or knowledge item in a representation space.

semts-dv:ExtremumProperty.label: Extremum Property
semts-dv:ExtremumProperty.def: A characteristic describing minimum, maximum, or extreme values and their positions.

semts-dv:FeatureImportance.label: Feature Importance
semts-dv:FeatureImportance.def: Attribution of a model’s prediction to input features or time steps.

semts-dv:FeatureVector.label: Feature Vector
semts-dv:FeatureVector.def: An ordered vector of extracted characteristics associated with a segment or group.

semts-dv:Forecast.label: Forecast
semts-dv:Forecast.def: Predicted future values or trajectories associated with a time-series segment or continuation.

semts-dv:FrequencyDomainProperty.label: Frequency-Domain Property
semts-dv:FrequencyDomainProperty.def: A characteristic derived from a frequency-domain or spectral representation.

semts-dv:HiddenStateSequence.label: Hidden State Sequence
semts-dv:HiddenStateSequence.def: Inferred latent states from Hidden Markov Models or similar probabilistic approaches.

semts-dv:Imputation.label: Imputation
semts-dv:Imputation.def: Estimated values supplied for missing or invalid observations in a time series.

semts-dv:IndirectCausalEffect.label: Indirect Causal Effect
semts-dv:IndirectCausalEffect.def: A causal effect mediated by one or more intermediate entities or relations.
semts-dv:IndirectCausalEffect.scope: Source has an indirect causal effect on target through one or more mediators.

semts-dv:InterventionEffect.label: Intervention Effect
semts-dv:InterventionEffect.def: Quantified impact of external interventions on time series behavior.

semts-dv:LocationProperty.label: Location Property
semts-dv:LocationProperty.def: Properties that define the position or location within data segments.

semts-dv:MagnitudeProperty.label: Magnitude Property
semts-dv:MagnitudeProperty.def: A characteristic describing the overall magnitude or energy of values.

semts-dv:Medoid.label: Medoid
semts-dv:Medoid.def: An observed group member selected as the representative with minimal aggregate distance to other members.

semts-dv:ModelUncertainty.label: Model Uncertainty
semts-dv:ModelUncertainty.def: Epistemic uncertainty arising from incomplete knowledge of model parameters.

semts-dv:Motif.label: Motif Group
semts-dv:Motif.def: A collection of motifs instances within time series data, representing a frequently occurring pattern that provides insights into underlying processes.

semts-dv:NecessaryConditionRelation.label: Necessary Condition Relation
semts-dv:NecessaryConditionRelation.def: A causal or logical relation in which the target cannot occur without the source condition.
semts-dv:NecessaryConditionRelation.scope: Source is a necessary condition for target.

semts-dv:OutOfDistribution.label: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detection
semts-dv:OutOfDistribution.def: Detection of inputs outside the training distribution.

semts-dv:Pattern.label: Pattern Group
semts-dv:Pattern.def: Group of repeating data segments with the same or similar behavior.

semts-dv:PeriodicityProperty.label: Periodicity Property
semts-dv:PeriodicityProperty.def: A characteristic describing repeated, seasonal, cyclic, or periodic behavior.

semts-dv:PredictedEvent.label: Predicted Event
semts-dv:PredictedEvent.def: Prediction of an event or action.

semts-dv:PredictionInterval.label: Prediction Interval
semts-dv:PredictionInterval.def: An interval quantifying forecast uncertainty at a given coverage level (e.g., 90%).

semts-dv:Prototype.label: Prototype
semts-dv:Prototype.def: A representative constructed to summarize a group of segments or knowledge items.

semts-dv:QuantileForecast.label: Quantile Forecast
semts-dv:QuantileForecast.def: Forecast expressed by one or more quantiles (e.g., 0.1, 0.5, 0.9).

semts-dv:RegimeChange.label: Regime Change
semts-dv:RegimeChange.def: Detection of transitions between different operational regimes in time series.

semts-dv:RegimeDetection.label: Regime Detection
semts-dv:RegimeDetection.def: Identification of different operational states or regimes within time series data.

semts-dv:ResidualComponent.label: Residual Component
semts-dv:ResidualComponent.def: Remaining variation after trend and seasonal components are removed from decomposition.

semts-dv:SeasonalComponent.label: Seasonal Component
semts-dv:SeasonalComponent.def: Extracted seasonal patterns from time series decomposition.

semts-dv:Segmentation.label: Segmentation Result
semts-dv:Segmentation.def: Knowledge describing a partition or boundary structure over a time series.

semts-dv:Shapelet.label: Shapelet
semts-dv:Shapelet.def: A characteristic subseries or pattern within a time series that is useful for classification.

semts-dv:Similarity.label: Similarity
semts-dv:Similarity.def: A quantified or qualified resemblance relation between segments, values, representations, or knowledge items.
semts-dv:Similarity.scope: Use as the concept of a semts:SegmentRelation that is attached to two or more segments through semts:multiSegmentKnowledge, or of a semts:UndirectedKnowledgeRelation when the similarity holds between knowledge items. Per-segment similarity features (for example query similarity counts) are segment data characteristics, not relations.

semts-dv:StateEstimate.label: State Estimate
semts-dv:StateEstimate.def: An inferred latent or observable state associated with a segment.

semts-dv:StructuralProperty.label: Structural Property
semts-dv:StructuralProperty.def: Attributes related to the composition or arrangement of data segments.

semts-dv:SufficientConditionRelation.label: Sufficient Condition Relation
semts-dv:SufficientConditionRelation.def: A causal or logical relation in which the source condition is sufficient for the target under the stated context.
semts-dv:SufficientConditionRelation.scope: Source is a sufficient condition for target under the represented context.

semts-dv:TemporalDependenceProperty.label: Temporal Dependence Property
semts-dv:TemporalDependenceProperty.def: Characteristic describing dependence between observations of the same time series across temporal offsets.

semts-dv:TemporalPointProcess.label: Temporal Point Process
semts-dv:TemporalPointProcess.def: A stochastic process modeling discrete events in time via an intensity function.

semts-dv:TimeFrequencyProperty.label: Time-Frequency Property
semts-dv:TimeFrequencyProperty.def: Characteristic describing how frequency content varies over time.

semts-dv:TrendComponent.label: Trend Component
semts-dv:TrendComponent.def: Long-term directional movement extracted from time series decomposition.

semts-dv:TrendProperty.label: Trend Property
semts-dv:TrendProperty.def: Indicators of directionality or movement within data segments over time.

semts-dv:Changepoint.label: Changepoint
semts-dv:Changepoint.def: Detection of shifts or changes in the underlying dynamics of data.

semts-dv:Cluster.label: Cluster
semts-dv:Cluster.def: A cluster represents one group from a clustering, characterized by shared properties.

semts-dv:Correlation.label: Correlation
semts-dv:Correlation.def: A statistical dependence relation between values, dimensions, segments, or knowledge items.
semts-dv:Correlation.scope: Use as the concept of a semts:SegmentRelation that is attached to two or more segments through semts:multiSegmentKnowledge, or of a semts:UndirectedKnowledgeRelation when the correlation holds between knowledge items, unless a directional statistical relation is explicitly intended. A correlation that is asserted by an expert rather than derived from the data is scenario knowledge (semts-sv:Correlation).

semts-dv:Distance.label: Distance
semts-dv:Distance.def: A quantified dissimilarity between segments, values, representations, or knowledge items.
semts-dv:Distance.scope: Use as the concept of a semts:SegmentRelation that is attached to two or more segments through semts:multiSegmentKnowledge, or of a semts:UndirectedKnowledgeRelation when the distance measure is symmetric. Asymmetric distances require a semts:DirectedKnowledgeRelation with an explicit source-to-target interpretation.

semts-dv:InferredClassID.label: Inferred Class ID
semts-dv:InferredClassID.def: A classification identifier derived from analysis and inference.

semts-dv:ModelInstance.label: Model Instance
semts-dv:ModelInstance.def: A model generated via machine learning.

semts-dv:MotifElement.label: Motif Element
semts-dv:MotifElement.def: A segment identified as an occurrence of a motif, modeled as a specialized pattern element.

semts-dv:RelationStructure.label: Relation Structure
semts-dv:RelationStructure.def: Structured representation of multiple relations among segments, variables, or knowledge entities.

semts-dv:ConditionRelation.label: Condition Relation
semts-dv:ConditionRelation.def: Relation expressing a necessary or sufficient condition without implying physical causation.

semts-dv:PatternElement.label: Pattern Element
semts-dv:PatternElement.def: A segment identified as an occurrence or member of a repeated or otherwise characteristic pattern.

semts-dv:RepresentationCharacteristic.label: Representation Characteristic
semts-dv:RepresentationCharacteristic.def: A learned or constructed representation of a segment, dimension, or group.

semts-dv:SegmentPrediction.label: Segment Prediction
semts-dv:SegmentPrediction.def: Knowledge related to predicting outcomes or future trends within data segments.

semts-dv:SegmentGroup.label: Segment Group
semts-dv:SegmentGroup.def: A collection of related segments within time series data.

semts-dv:DecompositionComponent.label: Decomposition Component
semts-dv:DecompositionComponent.def: Component obtained by decomposing a time series into interpretable constituent parts.

semts-dv:ProbabilisticForecast.label: Probabilistic Forecast
semts-dv:ProbabilisticForecast.def: A forecast represented as a probability distribution over future values, including quantiles or prediction intervals.

semts-dv:Causality.label: Causal Relation
semts-dv:Causality.def: A directed cause-effect relation inferred or estimated between segments, variables, events, or knowledge propositions. It is stronger than mere correlation.
semts-dv:Causality.scope: Use with semts:DirectedKnowledgeRelation when the source-to-target causal orientation is represented explicitly.

semts-dv:DataKnowledge.label: Data Knowledge
semts-dv:DataKnowledge.def: A comprehensive category encompassing various forms of knowledge derived from data analysis.

semts-dv:DataLevelPrediction.label: Data Level Prediction
semts-dv:DataLevelPrediction.def: Knowledge involving the generation of data inferred from existing data.

semts-dv:InferredAnnotation.label: Inferred Annotation
semts-dv:InferredAnnotation.def: Annotations derived from analysis that highlight inferred knowledge or insights.

semts-dv:SegmentGroupRepresentative.label: Segment Group Representative
semts-dv:SegmentGroupRepresentative.def: An entity that acts as a typical example or reference for a group of segments.

semts-dv:AnnotationLevelPrediction.label: Annotation Level Prediction
semts-dv:AnnotationLevelPrediction.def: Knowledge that enriches existing records by attaching labels or classes about outcomes such as events and anomalies.

semts-dv:SegmentRelation.label: Segment Relation
semts-dv:SegmentRelation.def: Relationships and connections between different data segments.

semts-dv:SegmentDataCharacteristic.label: Segment Data Characteristic
semts-dv:SegmentDataCharacteristic.def: Attributes and features that define specific data segments.

semts-sv:Conclusion.def: Outcome or finding derived from analysis, reasoning, or validation.

semts-sv:Condition.label: Condition
semts-sv:Condition.def: Boolean expressions used to evaluate conditions within time series data.

semts-sv:ContradictingEvidence.label: Contradicting Evidence
semts-sv:ContradictingEvidence.def: Evidence that contradicts or refutes an assumption or hypothesis.

semts-sv:Contradiction.label: Contradiction
semts-sv:Contradiction.def: Identified conflict or inconsistency between facts, assumptions, or observations.

semts-sv:ContributesTo.label: contributes to
semts-sv:ContributesTo.def: The source is one contributing factor for the target but is not asserted to be sufficient by itself.

semts-sv:ControlPlan.label: Control Plan
semts-sv:ControlPlan.def: Documented plan describing controls, checks, or interventions for an activity or system.

semts-sv:CorrectiveMaintenanceEvent.label: Corrective Maintenance Event
semts-sv:CorrectiveMaintenanceEvent.def: Maintenance performed to correct detected issues or failures.

semts-sv:Correlation.label: correlated with
semts-sv:Correlation.def: A scenario assertion that two entities, states, events, or knowledge propositions covary or are correlated, without necessarily deriving the relation from the associated time-series data.
semts-sv:Correlation.history: In version 1.3.0 the preferred label changed from 'Correlation' to 'correlated with', following the verb-phrase labels of the other relationship concepts.

semts-sv:CycleComplete.label: Cycle Complete
semts-sv:CycleComplete.def: Event marking the completion of a recurring or otherwise bounded cycle in any domain.

semts-sv:CycleStart.label: Cycle Start
semts-sv:CycleStart.def: Event marking the beginning of a recurring or otherwise bounded cycle in any domain.

semts-sv:Deadline.label: Deadline
semts-sv:Deadline.def: A time by which a condition, action, or outcome is expected.

semts-sv:Decision.label: Decision
semts-sv:Decision.def: A selected course of action or resolved choice.

semts-sv:Dependency.label: depends on
semts-sv:Dependency.def: Relationship indicating that the source entity, process, or knowledge proposition requires or is contingent on the target.
semts-sv:Dependency.history: In version 1.3.0 the preferred label changed from 'Dependency' to 'depends on', following the verb-phrase labels of the other relationship concepts.

semts-sv:DerivedFrom.label: derived from
semts-sv:DerivedFrom.def: The source knowledge is derived from the target knowledge or evidence.

semts-sv:DifferentialEquation.label: Differential Equation
semts-sv:DifferentialEquation.def: Differential Equations involve derivatives and are used to model dynamic changes and trends in time series data.

semts-sv:DispatchInstruction.label: Dispatch Instruction
semts-sv:DispatchInstruction.def: Instruction to assign or route work, orders, or tasks.

semts-sv:DowntimeCategory.label: Downtime Category
semts-sv:DowntimeCategory.def: Parameter categorizing downtime reasons or types.

semts-sv:Duration.label: Duration
semts-sv:Duration.def: A temporal extent associated with a scenario entity or event.

semts-sv:Enables.label: enables
semts-sv:Enables.def: The source creates a condition that makes the target possible.

semts-sv:EnvironmentalCondition.label: Environmental Condition
semts-sv:EnvironmentalCondition.def: Physical environmental factor such as temperature, humidity, or pressure affecting system behavior.

semts-sv:EquivalentTo.label: equivalent to
semts-sv:EquivalentTo.def: The participants are asserted to express equivalent meaning in the represented context.

semts-sv:ExpectedProfile.label: Expected Profile
semts-sv:ExpectedProfile.def: Expected temporal pattern or profile for a given context.

semts-sv:Explanation.label: Explanation
semts-sv:Explanation.def: Descriptive account clarifying why or how something occurred.

semts-sv:ExponentialEquation.label: Exponential Equation
semts-sv:ExponentialEquation.def: Exponential Equations model growth or decay processes in time series data using exponential functions.

semts-sv:ExternalEvent.label: External Event
semts-sv:ExternalEvent.def: Event originating outside the monitored system that affects observed behavior.

semts-sv:Forecast.label: Scenario Forecast
semts-sv:Forecast.def: An externally supplied or expert-authored projection used as scenario context or a plan. Data-derived forecasts belong in the data knowledge vocabulary.

semts-sv:Goal.label: Goal
semts-sv:Goal.def: A desired state or outcome relevant to the scenario.

semts-sv:Guideline.label: Guideline
semts-sv:Guideline.def: Recommendation that helps to make decisions and ensures correct, consistent application.

semts-sv:Hypothesis.label: Hypothesis
semts-sv:Hypothesis.def: Proposed explanation or prediction explicitly subject to verification or testing.

semts-sv:Inference.label: Inference
semts-sv:Inference.def: Knowledge or conclusion derived through reasoning from other facts or observations.

semts-sv:InferredFact.label: Inferred Fact
semts-sv:InferredFact.def: Fact derived through logical inference rather than direct observation.

semts-sv:InformalComment.label: Informal Comment
semts-sv:InformalComment.def: An informal note which can literally be any arbitrary message that is not covered by a predefined category.

semts-sv:IntegralEquation.label: Integral Equation
semts-sv:IntegralEquation.def: Integral Equations involve integrals and are used to analyze cumulative effects and total values in time series data.

semts-sv:Involvement.label: Involvement
semts-sv:Involvement.def: Annotation describing participation or role of an actor or entity.

semts-sv:Justification.label: Justification
semts-sv:Justification.def: Reasoning or explanation supporting a decision, conclusion, or annotation.

semts-sv:Keyword.label: Keyword
semts-sv:Keyword.def: Free-form tag used for categorization, organization and indexing.

semts-sv:Label.label: Label
semts-sv:Label.def: Labels are identifiers or markers added to time series data to categorize or highlight specific elements or features.

semts-sv:Location.label: Location
semts-sv:Location.def: Location associated with data, events, or entities.

semts-sv:LogarithmicEquation.label: Logarithmic Equation
semts-sv:LogarithmicEquation.def: Logarithmic Equations involve logarithms and are used to model multiplicative relationships in time series data.

semts-sv:MaintenancePlan.label: Maintenance Plan
semts-sv:MaintenancePlan.def: Plan describing maintenance strategy and tasks.

semts-sv:Milestone.label: Milestone
semts-sv:Milestone.def: Marker event indicating attainment of a significant state.

semts-sv:ModeChange.label: Mode Change
semts-sv:ModeChange.def: Change in operating mode or state.

semts-sv:NonConformance.label: Non-Conformance
semts-sv:NonConformance.def: Alert indicating that an entity, result, activity, or process does not satisfy an applicable requirement.

semts-sv:OperatingMode.label: Operating Mode
semts-sv:OperatingMode.def: Status indicating mode (e.g., automatic, manual, idle).

semts-sv:OperationalConstraint.label: Operational Constraint
semts-sv:OperationalConstraint.def: Constraint derived from operational requirements or physical limitations.

semts-sv:Outcome.label: Outcome
semts-sv:Outcome.def: A realized or expected result of an event, process, action, or decision.

semts-sv:PhaseTransition.label: Phase Transition
semts-sv:PhaseTransition.def: Transition from one operational phase or stage to another.

semts-sv:PolynomialEquation.label: Polynomial Equation
semts-sv:PolynomialEquation.def: Polynomial Equations consist of terms raised to powers, representing relationships and patterns within time series data.

semts-sv:PredictiveMaintenanceEvent.label: Predictive Maintenance Event
semts-sv:PredictiveMaintenanceEvent.def: Maintenance initiated based on prediction or condition monitoring.

semts-sv:PreventiveMaintenanceEvent.label: Preventive Maintenance Event
semts-sv:PreventiveMaintenanceEvent.def: Planned maintenance performed to prevent failures.

semts-sv:Prevents.label: prevents
semts-sv:Prevents.def: The source inhibits or blocks the target.

semts-sv:ProcessReference.label: Process Reference
semts-sv:ProcessReference.def: A reference to a process, activity, or workflow.

semts-sv:ProcessStep.label: Process Step
semts-sv:ProcessStep.def: Process step context associated with an event (e.g., shipping, receiving) or transaction context (e.g., purchase orders, invoices).

semts-sv:ProgramName.label: Program Name
semts-sv:ProgramName.def: Identifier of a program, job, or control block.

semts-sv:Purpose.label: Purpose
semts-sv:Purpose.def: Purpose or motivation of an annotation.

semts-sv:QualityAnnotation.label: Quality Annotation
semts-sv:QualityAnnotation.def: A contextual annotation about the quality, validity, fitness, or issue status of data or knowledge. Quantitative measures should use the SemTS quality-measure vocabulary.

semts-sv:RUL.label: Remaining Useful Life
semts-sv:RUL.def: An externally supplied, expert-authored, or scenario-configured remaining-useful-life value or estimate. Data-derived RUL estimates belong in the Data Knowledge vocabulary.
semts-sv:RUL.scope: Use this concept for scenario or common-context knowledge. Use a data-knowledge result concept when the value is generated analytically from time-series data.

semts-sv:Recipe.label: Recipe
semts-sv:Recipe.def: Named set of instructions or parameter settings used to configure or carry out an activity.

semts-sv:RecipeChangeEvent.label: Recipe Change Event
semts-sv:RecipeChangeEvent.def: Parameter change affecting the process recipe configuration.

semts-sv:Recurrence.label: Recurrence
semts-sv:Recurrence.def: A repeating temporal pattern or frequency associated with a scenario entity or event.

semts-sv:Refines.label: refines
semts-sv:Refines.def: The source adds detail, restricts, or improves the precision of the target.

semts-sv:Rejection.label: Rejection
semts-sv:Rejection.def: Action of rejecting or invalidating an assumption, hypothesis, or proposed information.

semts-sv:Requirement.label: Requirement
semts-sv:Requirement.def: A condition that must be satisfied in the scenario.

semts-sv:Requires.label: requires
semts-sv:Requires.def: The source requires the target as a prerequisite, input, or condition.

semts-sv:Reschedule.label: Reschedule
semts-sv:Reschedule.def: Action altering planned timing or sequence of activities.

semts-sv:ResetOrClear.label: Reset or Clear
semts-sv:ResetOrClear.def: Action to clear or reset a condition or alarm state.

semts-sv:ResourceReference.label: Resource Reference
semts-sv:ResourceReference.def: A reference to a material, document, dataset, service, or other resource.

semts-sv:Retraction.label: Retraction
semts-sv:Retraction.def: Action of withdrawing previously asserted information or annotations.

semts-sv:Revision.label: Revision
semts-sv:Revision.def: Action of modifying or updating previous knowledge, assumptions, or annotations based on new information.

semts-sv:Risk.label: Risk
semts-sv:Risk.def: A possible adverse outcome characterized by likelihood, impact, or both.

semts-sv:Schedule.label: Schedule
semts-sv:Schedule.def: Time-based plan specifying when activities or states should occur.

semts-sv:SchedulingPolicy.label: Scheduling Policy
semts-sv:SchedulingPolicy.def: Rule defining scheduling and dispatch policies.

semts-sv:SensorDeployment.label: Sensor Deployment
semts-sv:SensorDeployment.def: Deployment or installation of a sensor.

semts-sv:SetpointChange.label: Setpoint Change
semts-sv:SetpointChange.def: Parameter change affecting a control setpoint value.

semts-sv:Setting.label: Setting
semts-sv:Setting.def: A contextual configuration composed of parameters, conditions, references, and states.

semts-sv:SimilarTo.label: similar to
semts-sv:SimilarTo.def: The participants are asserted to be similar under an implicit or explicit criterion.

semts-sv:SoftwareUpdate.label: Software Update
semts-sv:SoftwareUpdate.def: Software update applied to a device or system.

semts-sv:StateDescription.label: State Description
semts-sv:StateDescription.def: A description of the state or condition of an entity, process, system, or environment.

semts-sv:Supersedes.label: supersedes
semts-sv:Supersedes.def: The source replaces the target as the currently preferred or valid assertion.

semts-sv:SupportingEvidence.label: Supporting Evidence
semts-sv:SupportingEvidence.def: Evidence that confirms or supports an assumption or hypothesis.

semts-sv:SystemReference.label: System Reference
semts-sv:SystemReference.def: A reference to a system, subsystem, component, or asset.

semts-sv:TemporalConstraint.label: Temporal Constraint
semts-sv:TemporalConstraint.def: Constraint specifying timing requirements, durations, or sequencing rules.

semts-sv:Threshold.label: Threshold
semts-sv:Threshold.def: Boundary value used for conditions, alarms, or logic.

semts-sv:ThresholdBreach.label: Threshold Breach
semts-sv:ThresholdBreach.def: Alert raised when a defined threshold is exceeded or violated.

semts-sv:ThresholdChange.label: Threshold Change
semts-sv:ThresholdChange.def: Parameter change adjusting a threshold used in control, alarms, or logic.

semts-sv:TimeWindow.label: Time Window
semts-sv:TimeWindow.def: A temporal interval relevant to the scenario.

semts-sv:Tolerance.label: Tolerance
semts-sv:Tolerance.def: Acceptable deviation range from a reference value.

semts-sv:Triggers.label: triggers
semts-sv:Triggers.def: The source initiates the target when relevant conditions hold.

semts-sv:TrigonometricEquation.label: Trigonometric Equation
semts-sv:TrigonometricEquation.def: Trigonometric Equations use trigonometric functions to represent periodic patterns and cycles in time series data.

semts-sv:UnplannedDowntime.label: Unplanned Downtime
semts-sv:UnplannedDowntime.def: Unscheduled outage or stop due to failure or other causes.

semts-sv:UserEvent.label: User Event
semts-sv:UserEvent.def: Event initiated by a user or operator.

semts-sv:ValidationEvent.label: Validation Event
semts-sv:ValidationEvent.def: Event documenting the validation or verification of information or assumptions.

semts-sv:ValidationOutcome.label: Validation Outcome
semts-sv:ValidationOutcome.def: Result or conclusion of a validation or verification process.

semts-sv:ValidationStatus.label: Validation Status
semts-sv:ValidationStatus.def: Status indicating the validation state of information (e.g., pending, validated, invalidated).

semts-sv:WearState.label: Wear State
semts-sv:WearState.def: State describing accumulated wear or degradation of an entity.

semts-sv:Assumption.label: Assumption
semts-sv:Assumption.def: Assumptions are hypotheses or premises considered within the context of analyzing time series data.

semts-sv:Causes.label: causes
semts-sv:Causes.def: The source produces or brings about the target under the represented context.

semts-sv:ConflictsWith.label: conflicts with
semts-sv:ConflictsWith.def: The participants cannot simultaneously hold, comply, or apply under the represented context.

semts-sv:Contradicts.label: contradicts
semts-sv:Contradicts.def: The source conflicts with or provides evidence against the target.

semts-sv:Explains.label: explains
semts-sv:Explains.def: The source provides an explanation for the target.

semts-sv:ExternalCondition.label: External Condition
semts-sv:ExternalCondition.def: External factor or condition outside the monitored system that influences observed behavior.

semts-sv:Fact.label: Fact
semts-sv:Fact.def: Evaluated statement that holds true and equals ground truth information.

semts-sv:Note.label: Note
semts-sv:Note.def: Notes are brief pieces of information that are added to time series data to highlight important aspects or observations.

semts-sv:Observation.label: Observation
semts-sv:Observation.def: Observations are specific perceptions made based on time series behaviors.

semts-sv:Plan.label: Plan
semts-sv:Plan.def: Documented intended course of action specifying what should occur.

semts-sv:SetupChangeover.label: Setup Changeover
semts-sv:SetupChangeover.def: Event in which an entity or activity changes from one setup or configuration to another.

semts-sv:Supports.label: supports
semts-sv:Supports.def: The source provides evidence or justification for accepting the target.

semts-sv:UncategorizedEvent.label: Uncategorized Event
semts-sv:UncategorizedEvent.def: An event that is not predefined and thus an unexpected observation.

semts-sv:Validates.label: validates
semts-sv:Validates.def: The source confirms the target against a criterion, procedure, or evidence base.

semts-sv:Constraint.label: Constraint
semts-sv:Constraint.def: Restriction or limitation governing system behavior or valid operating ranges.

semts-sv:DowntimeEvent.label: Downtime Event
semts-sv:DowntimeEvent.def: An event or interval in which an entity, service, system, process, or activity is unavailable or not operating as intended.
semts-sv:DowntimeEvent.scope: Domain-neutral concept. A domain extension may define narrower concepts such as machine downtime.

semts-sv:Evidence.label: Evidence
semts-sv:Evidence.def: Information or data supporting or refuting an assumption, hypothesis, or conclusion.

semts-sv:FormalDescription.label: Formal Description
semts-sv:FormalDescription.def: Formal Description provides formally defined background or situational details that enhance the understanding of time series data.

semts-sv:Relationship.label: Relationship
semts-sv:Relationship.def: Known association or connection between entities, variables, or time series.

semts-sv:Alert.label: Alert
semts-sv:Alert.def: User-facing notification about conditions or events affecting service or entities.

semts-sv:ParameterChange.label: Parameter Change
semts-sv:ParameterChange.def: Action/event indicating modification of one or more Scenario Parameters.

semts-sv:Reference.label: Reference
semts-sv:Reference.def: Expected value, behavior, or profile against which observations are compared.

semts-sv:EntityReference.label: Entity Reference
semts-sv:EntityReference.def: A parameter that identifies or refers to an entity relevant to the scenario.

semts-sv:Rule.label: Rule
semts-sv:Rule.def: Information which can be regarded a restriction or instruction.

semts-sv:LifecycleEvent.label: Lifecycle Event
semts-sv:LifecycleEvent.def: Event marking activity lifecycle transitions such as start, complete, suspend, or resume.

semts-sv:ScenarioKnowledge.label: Scenario Knowledge
semts-sv:ScenarioKnowledge.def: Scenario Knowledge encompasses structured information and insights relevant to understanding and analyzing specific situations in time series data.

semts-sv:Documentation.label: Documentation
semts-sv:Documentation.def: Description of a procedure or process.

semts-sv:MaintenanceEvent.label: Maintenance Event
semts-sv:MaintenanceEvent.def: Event documenting scheduled or unscheduled maintenance activities for assets or devices.

semts-sv:Status.label: Status
semts-sv:Status.def: Categorical or ordinal state of an entity, device, process, service, or event at a point in time (e.g., active/inactive, open/closed, enabled/disabled, acknowledged/unacknowledged).

semts-sv:UndirectedRelationship.label: Undirected Relationship
semts-sv:UndirectedRelationship.def: A relationship concept whose participants are unordered.

semts-sv:Annotation.label: Annotation
semts-sv:Annotation.def: Annotations are labels added to time series data to provide validated context or information for better understanding.

semts-sv:MathExpression.label: Math Expression
semts-sv:MathExpression.def: Math Expressions are mathematical formulas or equations used to model or analyze time series data.

semts-sv:Action.label: Action
semts-sv:Action.def: An action that equals a predefined event. Commonly performed to change or correct a certain process behavior.

semts-sv:CategorizedEvent.label: Categorized Event
semts-sv:CategorizedEvent.def: An event that is predefined and not an unexpected observation.

semts-sv:DirectedRelationship.label: Directed Relationship
semts-sv:DirectedRelationship.def: A relationship concept whose meaning is interpreted from relation source to relation target.
semts-sv:DirectedRelationship.scope: Use with semts:DirectedKnowledgeRelation. The source-to-target orientation follows the concept definition.

semts-sv:ScenarioParameter.label: Scenario Parameter
semts-sv:ScenarioParameter.def: Scenario Parameters are variables related to specific scenarios.

semts-sv:ContextualDescription.label: Contextual Description
semts-sv:ContextualDescription.def: Contextual description provides background or situational details that enhance the understanding of time series data.

semts-msv:MachineDowntime.label: Machine Downtime
semts-msv:MachineDowntime.def: Downtime of a machine or machine subsystem.
semts-msv:MachineDowntime.scope: A genuine manufacturing specialization because it constrains the affected entity to a machine.

semts-msv:ManufacturingToolWearState.label: Manufacturing Tool Wear State
semts-msv:ManufacturingToolWearState.def: Wear state of a tool used in a manufacturing operation.
semts-msv:ManufacturingToolWearState.scope: A genuine manufacturing specialization because it constrains the worn entity and operational context.

semts-msv:ManufacturingScenarioKnowledge.label: Manufacturing Scenario Knowledge
semts-msv:ManufacturingScenarioKnowledge.def: Organizing concept for scenario-knowledge meanings that are genuinely specific to manufacturing.
semts-msv:ManufacturingScenarioKnowledge.scope: This extension is intentionally small. It demonstrates how domain-specific concepts can specialize the scenario core without mechanically prefixing or suffixing generic terms.

semts-gv:AbductiveReasoning.label: Abductive Reasoning
semts-gv:AbductiveReasoning.def: Generation of plausible explanations for observations.

semts-gv:Abstraction.label: Abstraction
semts-gv:Abstraction.def: Generation of a higher-level representation that omits non-essential detail.

semts-gv:Aggregation.label: Aggregation
semts-gv:Aggregation.def: Combination of multiple values or knowledge items into a summary.

semts-gv:AnomalyDetection.label: Anomaly Detection
semts-gv:AnomalyDetection.def: Identification of observations or segments that deviate from an expected reference.

semts-gv:AssociationRuleMining.label: Association Rule Mining
semts-gv:AssociationRuleMining.def: Discovery of conditional co-occurrence or dependency rules.

semts-gv:BaselineComparison.label: Baseline Comparison
semts-gv:BaselineComparison.def: Comparison of an input with a baseline or reference.

semts-gv:CausalDiscovery.label: Causal Discovery
semts-gv:CausalDiscovery.def: Discovery of candidate causal structures or cause-effect relations.

semts-gv:CausalEffectEstimation.label: Causal Effect Estimation
semts-gv:CausalEffectEstimation.def: Estimation of the magnitude or distribution of causal effects.

semts-gv:CausalReasoning.label: Causal Reasoning
semts-gv:CausalReasoning.def: Reasoning over causes, effects, interventions, and counterfactuals.

semts-gv:ChangePointDetection.label: Change-Point Detection
semts-gv:ChangePointDetection.def: Identification of points or intervals where the data-generating behavior changes.

semts-gv:Classification.label: Classification
semts-gv:Classification.def: Assignment of one or more predefined classes or labels.

semts-gv:Clustering.label: Clustering
semts-gv:Clustering.def: Grouping of segments or knowledge items according to similarity or another relation.

semts-gv:ConflictResolution.label: Conflict Resolution
semts-gv:ConflictResolution.def: Resolution or qualification of conflicting knowledge or evidence.

semts-gv:ConsensusBuilding.label: Consensus Building
semts-gv:ConsensusBuilding.def: Generation of an agreed knowledge assertion from multiple contributors.

semts-gv:ConsistencyChecking.label: Consistency Checking
semts-gv:ConsistencyChecking.def: Detection or resolution of logical or semantic conflicts.

semts-gv:ConstraintChecking.label: Constraint Checking
semts-gv:ConstraintChecking.def: Validation or derivation based on explicit constraints.

semts-gv:CorrelationAnalysis.label: Correlation Analysis
semts-gv:CorrelationAnalysis.def: Generation of correlation or statistical dependence knowledge.

semts-gv:CrossSpectralAnalysis.label: Cross-Spectral Analysis
semts-gv:CrossSpectralAnalysis.def: Generation of frequency-domain relations between time series.

semts-gv:DeductiveReasoning.label: Deductive Reasoning
semts-gv:DeductiveReasoning.def: Derivation of conclusions that follow from represented premises and rules.

semts-gv:DependencyAnalysis.label: Dependency Analysis
semts-gv:DependencyAnalysis.def: Generation of dependency relations without necessarily asserting causation.

semts-gv:DistanceComputation.label: Distance Computation
semts-gv:DistanceComputation.def: Generation of distance or dissimilarity values.

semts-gv:EventDetection.label: Event Detection
semts-gv:EventDetection.def: Identification of event occurrences from time-series data.

semts-gv:EvidenceAggregation.label: Evidence Aggregation
semts-gv:EvidenceAggregation.def: Combination of multiple evidence items into a summary or score.

semts-gv:EvidenceSynthesis.label: Evidence Synthesis
semts-gv:EvidenceSynthesis.def: Structured integration of evidence into a conclusion or explanation.

semts-gv:ExpertAnnotation.label: Expert Annotation
semts-gv:ExpertAnnotation.def: Creation of labels, notes, events, relations, or other knowledge by an expert.

semts-gv:ExpertAssessment.label: Expert Assessment
semts-gv:ExpertAssessment.def: Human evaluation of quality, relevance, cause, risk, or another property.

semts-gv:ExpertValidation.label: Expert Validation
semts-gv:ExpertValidation.def: Human confirmation or rejection of generated or asserted knowledge.

semts-gv:ExplanationGeneration.label: Explanation Generation
semts-gv:ExplanationGeneration.def: Generation of explanatory knowledge for an observation, prediction, relation, or decision.

semts-gv:FeatureSelection.label: Feature Selection
semts-gv:FeatureSelection.def: Selection of a subset of available features according to relevance, redundancy, cost, or another criterion.

semts-gv:Forecasting.label: Forecasting
semts-gv:Forecasting.def: Prediction of future values, events, or trajectories.

semts-gv:FrequencyDomainFeatureExtractio.label: Frequency-Domain Feature Extraction
semts-gv:FrequencyDomainFeatureExtractio.def: Extraction of spectral or frequency-domain characteristics.

semts-gv:GroupComparison.label: Group Comparison
semts-gv:GroupComparison.def: Comparison involving sets or groups of inputs.

semts-gv:HyperparameterOptimization.label: Hyperparameter Optimization
semts-gv:HyperparameterOptimization.def: Search or optimization over method hyperparameters.

semts-gv:Imputation.label: Imputation
semts-gv:Imputation.def: Estimation of values for missing, invalid, or excluded observations.

semts-gv:InductiveReasoning.label: Inductive Reasoning
semts-gv:InductiveReasoning.def: Derivation of generalized conclusions from observations or examples.

semts-gv:KnowledgeExtraction.label: Knowledge Extraction
semts-gv:KnowledgeExtraction.def: Generation of explicit characteristics, structures, labels, or relations from data or existing knowledge.

semts-gv:Matching.label: Matching
semts-gv:Matching.def: Identification of compatible, corresponding, or nearest entities.

semts-gv:ModelSelection.label: Model Selection
semts-gv:ModelSelection.def: Selection among candidate models according to a criterion.

semts-gv:ModelTraining.label: Model Training
semts-gv:ModelTraining.def: Fitting a model or its parameters using data or knowledge inputs.

semts-gv:MotifDiscovery.label: Motif Discovery
semts-gv:MotifDiscovery.def: Discovery of repeated or similar subsequences.

semts-gv:ProbabilisticReasoning.label: Probabilistic Reasoning
semts-gv:ProbabilisticReasoning.def: Reasoning under uncertainty using probabilistic representations.

semts-gv:ProfileComparison.label: Profile Comparison
semts-gv:ProfileComparison.def: Comparison of an observed profile with an expected or reference profile.

semts-gv:Ranking.label: Ranking
semts-gv:Ranking.def: Ordering of entities according to one or more comparison criteria.

semts-gv:Regression.label: Regression
semts-gv:Regression.def: Estimation of continuous or ordered target values.

semts-gv:ReinforcementLearning.label: Reinforcement Learning
semts-gv:ReinforcementLearning.def: Learning behavior through interaction and reward signals.

semts-gv:RemainingUsefulLifeEstimation.label: Remaining Useful Life Estimation
semts-gv:RemainingUsefulLifeEstimation.def: Estimation of the remaining duration until a defined end-of-life condition.

semts-gv:RepresentationLearning.label: Representation Learning
semts-gv:RepresentationLearning.def: Learning a representation, embedding, or latent feature space from data.

semts-gv:RuleBasedReasoning.label: Rule-Based Reasoning
semts-gv:RuleBasedReasoning.def: Application of explicit rules to derive or validate knowledge.

semts-gv:Segmentation.label: Segmentation
semts-gv:Segmentation.def: Identification of meaningful boundaries or partitions in time-series data.

semts-gv:SelfSupervisedLearning.label: Self-supervised Learning
semts-gv:SelfSupervisedLearning.def: Learning from targets constructed from the input data itself.

semts-gv:SemiSupervisedLearning.label: Semi-supervised Learning
semts-gv:SemiSupervisedLearning.def: Learning from a mixture of labeled and unlabeled examples.

semts-gv:ShapeFeatureExtraction.label: Shape Feature Extraction
semts-gv:ShapeFeatureExtraction.def: Extraction of characteristics describing local or global signal shape.

semts-gv:ShapeletDiscovery.label: Shapelet Discovery
semts-gv:ShapeletDiscovery.def: Discovery of discriminative subsequences useful for classification or interpretation.

semts-gv:SimilarityAnalysis.label: Similarity Analysis
semts-gv:SimilarityAnalysis.def: Generation of similarity relations or scores.

semts-gv:Simulation.label: Simulation
semts-gv:Simulation.def: Generation of knowledge by executing a model of a process or system.

semts-gv:StateEstimation.label: State Estimation
semts-gv:StateEstimation.def: Estimation of latent or observable states associated with time-series behavior.

semts-gv:StatisticalFeatureExtraction.label: Statistical Feature Extraction
semts-gv:StatisticalFeatureExtraction.def: Extraction of distributional, location, dispersion, or other statistical characteristics.

semts-gv:SupervisedLearning.label: Supervised Learning
semts-gv:SupervisedLearning.def: Learning from examples associated with target labels or values.

semts-gv:TemporalFeatureExtraction.label: Temporal Feature Extraction
semts-gv:TemporalFeatureExtraction.def: Extraction of characteristics based on ordering, lag, duration, change, trend, or temporal structure.

semts-gv:TemporalReasoning.label: Temporal Reasoning
semts-gv:TemporalReasoning.def: Reasoning over temporal order, intervals, duration, recurrence, or change.

semts-gv:ThresholdComparison.label: Threshold Comparison
semts-gv:ThresholdComparison.def: Comparison of a value or knowledge item with a threshold or rule boundary.

semts-gv:TimeFrequencyFeatureExtraction.label: Time-Frequency Feature Extraction
semts-gv:TimeFrequencyFeatureExtraction.def: Extraction of characteristics localized jointly in time and frequency.

semts-gv:UnsupervisedLearning.label: Unsupervised Learning
semts-gv:UnsupervisedLearning.def: Learning structures or representations without target labels.

semts-gv:EvidenceIntegration.label: Evidence Integration
semts-gv:EvidenceIntegration.def: Generation of knowledge by combining supporting and contradicting evidence.

semts-gv:FeatureEngineering.label: Feature Engineering
semts-gv:FeatureEngineering.def: Generation activity that constructs, extracts, transforms, or selects representations used for analysis.

semts-gv:KnowledgeSummarization.label: Knowledge Summarization
semts-gv:KnowledgeSummarization.def: Generation of a reduced or abstract description from multiple data or knowledge inputs.

semts-gv:ModelDevelopment.label: Model Development
semts-gv:ModelDevelopment.def: Generation, selection, adaptation, or optimization of models used to produce knowledge.

semts-gv:ReasoningBasedGeneration.label: Reasoning-Based Generation
semts-gv:ReasoningBasedGeneration.def: Knowledge generation based on logical, probabilistic, causal, temporal, human, or hybrid reasoning.

semts-gv:HumanKnowledgeAcquisition.label: Human Knowledge Acquisition
semts-gv:HumanKnowledgeAcquisition.def: Generation or validation of knowledge through human input.

semts-gv:AlgorithmRecommendation.label: Algorithm Recommendation
semts-gv:AlgorithmRecommendation.def: Knowledge that a particular algorithm is appropriate or optimal for analysing the associated segments for a given task.
semts-gv:AlgorithmRecommendation.scope: Use as the concept of a semts:Algorithm instance. The instance is itself an mls:Algorithm, so the algorithm family can be stated with mlso:hasAlgorithmType (for example http://w3id.org/mlso/vocab/ml_algorithm/AutoEncoder). semts:hasValue carries the identifier or configuration of the recommended implementation.

semts-gv:AnalyticalEquivalent.label: Analytical Equivalent
semts-gv:AnalyticalEquivalent.def: A mathematical or logical expression that is equivalent to established process information and can be used in place of a learned or measured quantity when analysing the associated segments.
semts-gv:AnalyticalEquivalent.scope: Use as the concept of a semts:MethodKnowledge instance whose value holds the expression, for example a formula that reproduces a controller set-point curve.

semts-gv:HyperparameterRecommendation.label: Hyperparameter Recommendation
semts-gv:HyperparameterRecommendation.def: Knowledge that a particular hyperparameter setting is appropriate or optimal for analysing the associated segments for a given task.
semts-gv:HyperparameterRecommendation.scope: Use as the concept of a semts:Hyperparameter instance. Name the hyperparameter in semts:title and give the recommended setting in semts:hasValue.

semts-gv:MethodConfiguration.label: Method Configuration
semts-gv:MethodConfiguration.def: A named, complete configuration of an analytical method, such as an algorithm together with its parameter settings and preprocessing steps, that has proven effective for the associated segments.
semts-gv:MethodConfiguration.scope: Use as the concept of a semts:MethodKnowledge instance, or of a semts:KnowledgeGroup that bundles the individual algorithm and hyperparameter recommendations.

semts-gv:MethodKnowledge.label: Method Knowledge
semts-gv:MethodKnowledge.def: Knowledge about an analytical method, or a setting of a method, that is appropriate or optimal when analysing the associated segments for a given task.
semts-gv:MethodKnowledge.scope: Unlike the concepts under Knowledge Generation, which classify how knowledge was produced, these concepts classify knowledge about methods: what worked, with which settings, for which data. They are semts:KnowledgeConcept and are used with semts:knowledgeConcept.

semts-gv:PreprocessingRecommendation.label: Preprocessing Recommendation
semts-gv:PreprocessingRecommendation.def: Knowledge that a particular preprocessing step, such as resampling, normalisation, filtering or imputation, is appropriate before analysing the associated segments.

semts-gv:KnowledgeGeneration.label: Knowledge Generation
semts-gv:KnowledgeGeneration.def: A process that produces, compares, validates, derives, or otherwise generates SemTS knowledge.

semts-gv:FeatureExtraction.label: Feature Extraction
semts-gv:FeatureExtraction.def: Generation of descriptive features or characteristics from time-series data or representations.

semts-gv:LearningBasedGeneration.label: Learning-Based Generation
semts-gv:LearningBasedGeneration.def: Method-based generation in which a model or representation is learned from examples or interaction.

semts-gv:PatternDiscovery.label: Pattern Discovery
semts-gv:PatternDiscovery.def: Discovery of repeated, characteristic, grouped, or sequential structures.

semts-gv:ComparisonBasedGeneration.label: Comparison-Based Generation
semts-gv:ComparisonBasedGeneration.def: Knowledge generation based primarily on comparing compatible data or knowledge inputs.

semts-gv:RelationAnalysis.label: Relation Analysis
semts-gv:RelationAnalysis.def: Generation of relations among segments, dimensions, events, values, or knowledge items.

semts-gv:AutomatedReasoning.label: Automated Reasoning
semts-gv:AutomatedReasoning.def: Generation of knowledge by a reasoning system.

semts-gv:MethodBasedGeneration.label: Method-Based Generation
semts-gv:MethodBasedGeneration.def: Knowledge generation performed by an analytical or computational implementation.

semts-gv:PredictiveAnalysis.label: Predictive Analysis
semts-gv:PredictiveAnalysis.def: Generation of predictions, estimates, labels, states, or future values.

semts-qv:Agreement.label: Agreement
semts-qv:Agreement.def: Degree of concordance among sources, models, experts, annotations, or repeated measurements.

semts-qv:Applicability.label: Applicability
semts-qv:Applicability.def: Degree to which knowledge can be applied under the conditions of a target segment or scenario.

semts-qv:AreaUnderROCCurve.label: Area Under the ROC Curve
semts-qv:AreaUnderROCCurve.def: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve across decision thresholds.

semts-qv:Calibration.label: Calibration
semts-qv:Calibration.def: Degree to which predicted probabilities or intervals correspond to observed frequencies.

semts-qv:CausalStrength.label: Causal Strength
semts-qv:CausalStrength.def: Magnitude or confidence of a causal influence or effect.

semts-qv:Certainty.label: Certainty
semts-qv:Certainty.def: Degree to which uncertainty about a knowledge assertion has been resolved.

semts-qv:ClassificationAccuracy.label: Classification Accuracy
semts-qv:ClassificationAccuracy.def: Proportion of classified instances whose predicted class is correct.

semts-qv:CoefficientOfDetermination.label: Coefficient of Determination
semts-qv:CoefficientOfDetermination.def: Proportion of observed variance explained by point predictions.

semts-qv:Completeness.label: Completeness
semts-qv:Completeness.def: Degree to which required content, coverage, relations, or contextual information is present.

semts-qv:ComputationalCost.label: Computational Cost
semts-qv:ComputationalCost.def: Aggregate computational resources required by a knowledge process.

semts-qv:Confidence.label: Confidence
semts-qv:Confidence.def: Quantified or qualified belief in the correctness or reliability of a knowledge assertion.

semts-qv:Consistency.label: Consistency
semts-qv:Consistency.def: Degree to which knowledge is free of internal conflict or contradiction with relevant knowledge.

semts-qv:ContinuousRankedProbabilityScor.label: Continuous Ranked Probability Score
semts-qv:ContinuousRankedProbabilityScor.def: Proper score comparing a predictive cumulative distribution with an observed outcome.

semts-qv:Correctness.label: Correctness
semts-qv:Correctness.def: Degree to which knowledge agrees with an accepted reference, fact, or validation outcome.

semts-qv:CosineSimilarity.label: Cosine Similarity
semts-qv:CosineSimilarity.def: Similarity based on the cosine of the angle between vector representations.

semts-qv:Coverage.label: Coverage
semts-qv:Coverage.def: Extent of the relevant temporal, dimensional, segment, class, or scenario space addressed by the knowledge.

semts-qv:CrossCorrelation.label: Cross-Correlation
semts-qv:CrossCorrelation.def: Correlation between sequences as a function of temporal lag.

semts-qv:Dissimilarity.label: Dissimilarity
semts-qv:Dissimilarity.def: Degree of non-resemblance between compared entities.

semts-qv:DynamicTimeWarpingDistance.label: Dynamic Time Warping Distance
semts-qv:DynamicTimeWarpingDistance.def: Alignment-based distance between sequences that permits nonlinear temporal warping.

semts-qv:EuclideanDistance.label: Euclidean Distance
semts-qv:EuclideanDistance.def: Straight-line distance between two numeric vectors.

semts-qv:EvidenceStrength.label: Evidence Strength
semts-qv:EvidenceStrength.def: Strength and adequacy of evidence supporting or contradicting knowledge.

semts-qv:Explainability.label: Explainability
semts-qv:Explainability.def: Degree to which reasons or mechanisms for a knowledge result can be communicated.

semts-qv:F1Score.label: F1 Score
semts-qv:F1Score.def: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.

semts-qv:Fidelity.label: Fidelity
semts-qv:Fidelity.def: Degree to which an explanation reflects the behavior of the process or model it explains.

semts-qv:Freshness.label: Freshness
semts-qv:Freshness.def: Degree to which knowledge reflects the current state of its subject.

semts-qv:Interpretability.label: Interpretability
semts-qv:Interpretability.def: Degree to which a human can understand the meaning or behavior represented by knowledge.

semts-qv:IntervalCoverage.label: Interval Coverage
semts-qv:IntervalCoverage.def: Fraction of reference outcomes contained in prediction or confidence intervals.

semts-qv:IntervalWidth.label: Interval Width
semts-qv:IntervalWidth.def: Width of an uncertainty interval, often interpreted together with interval coverage.

semts-qv:JaccardSimilarity.label: Jaccard Similarity
semts-qv:JaccardSimilarity.def: Similarity defined as the size of an intersection divided by the size of the corresponding union.

semts-qv:ManhattanDistance.label: Manhattan Distance
semts-qv:ManhattanDistance.def: Sum of absolute coordinate-wise differences between two numeric vectors.

semts-qv:MeanAbsoluteError.label: Mean Absolute Error
semts-qv:MeanAbsoluteError.def: Mean absolute difference between observed and predicted values.

semts-qv:MeanAbsolutePercentageError.label: Mean Absolute Percentage Error
semts-qv:MeanAbsolutePercentageError.def: Mean absolute prediction error relative to observed magnitude, expressed as a percentage.

semts-qv:MeanAbsoluteScaledError.label: Mean Absolute Scaled Error
semts-qv:MeanAbsoluteScaledError.def: Mean absolute prediction error scaled by a baseline forecast error.

semts-qv:MeanSquaredError.label: Mean Squared Error
semts-qv:MeanSquaredError.def: Mean squared difference between observed and predicted values.

semts-qv:MemoryUse.label: Memory Use
semts-qv:MemoryUse.def: Memory required by a knowledge generation or evaluation process.

semts-qv:PearsonCorrelation.label: Pearson Correlation
semts-qv:PearsonCorrelation.def: Linear correlation coefficient between paired numeric variables or sequences.

semts-qv:Precision.label: Precision
semts-qv:Precision.def: Fraction of predicted positive cases that are relevant or correct.

semts-qv:PredictiveAccuracy.label: Point Prediction Accuracy
semts-qv:PredictiveAccuracy.def: Overall closeness of point predictions to observed values, without prescribing a particular error formula.
semts-qv:PredictiveAccuracy.scope: Not the classification accuracy of MLSO (evaluation_measure/accuracy), which counts correctly classified instances. That measure corresponds to Classification Accuracy.

semts-qv:Recall.label: Recall
semts-qv:Recall.def: Fraction of relevant or positive cases that are successfully identified.

semts-qv:Relevance.label: Relevance
semts-qv:Relevance.def: Degree to which knowledge is useful for the stated task, purpose, or decision context.

semts-qv:Reliability.label: Reliability
semts-qv:Reliability.def: Degree to which knowledge or its generation process produces dependable results.

semts-qv:Representativeness.label: Representativeness
semts-qv:Representativeness.def: Degree to which knowledge reflects the population, behavior, or context for which it is used.

semts-qv:Reproducibility.label: Reproducibility
semts-qv:Reproducibility.def: Degree to which the knowledge result can be regenerated under documented conditions.

semts-qv:Robustness.label: Robustness
semts-qv:Robustness.def: Degree to which knowledge remains valid or stable under perturbations, alternative samples, or reasonable parameter changes.

semts-qv:RootMeanSquaredError.label: Root Mean Squared Error
semts-qv:RootMeanSquaredError.def: Square root of the mean squared prediction error.

semts-qv:Runtime.label: Runtime
semts-qv:Runtime.def: Elapsed or processor time required to generate, compare, validate, or reason over knowledge.

semts-qv:SilhouetteCoefficient.label: Silhouette Coefficient
semts-qv:SilhouetteCoefficient.def: Clustering quality based on within-cluster cohesion and separation from other clusters.

semts-qv:Specificity.label: Specificity
semts-qv:Specificity.def: Degree to which knowledge is precise and narrowly characterized rather than vague or overly general.
semts-qv:Specificity.scope: An intrinsic quality of knowledge. Not the classification measure that is also called specificity (true negative rate).

semts-qv:Stability.label: Stability
semts-qv:Stability.def: Degree to which an explanation or knowledge result remains similar under small, non-material changes.

semts-qv:SymmetricMeanAbsolutePercentage.label: Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error
semts-qv:SymmetricMeanAbsolutePercentage.def: Percentage error normalized symmetrically by observed and predicted magnitudes.

semts-qv:Timeliness.label: Timeliness
semts-qv:Timeliness.def: Degree to which knowledge is available at an appropriate time for its intended use.

semts-qv:Traceability.label: Traceability
semts-qv:Traceability.def: Degree to which knowledge can be traced to inputs, sources, methods, and decisions.

semts-qv:Uncertainty.label: Uncertainty
semts-qv:Uncertainty.def: Degree or characterization of incomplete knowledge about a value, relation, event, or assertion.

semts-qv:Validity.label: Validity
semts-qv:Validity.def: Degree to which knowledge satisfies applicable rules, constraints, assumptions, or validation criteria.

semts-qv:ClusteringPerformance.label: Clustering Performance
semts-qv:ClusteringPerformance.def: Performance or quality of a clustering result.

semts-qv:ProvenanceQuality.label: Provenance Quality
semts-qv:ProvenanceQuality.def: A measure of traceability and reproducibility of knowledge and its generation.

semts-qv:Similarity.label: Similarity
semts-qv:Similarity.def: Degree of resemblance between compared entities under a specified representation or criterion.

semts-qv:Correlation.label: Correlation
semts-qv:Correlation.def: Strength and direction of statistical association between compared entities.

semts-qv:Distance.label: Distance
semts-qv:Distance.def: A metric or measure of separation between compared entities.

semts-qv:OperationalQuality.label: Operational Quality
semts-qv:OperationalQuality.def: A measure of computational or operational behavior associated with knowledge generation.

semts-qv:PointPredictionPerformance.label: Point Prediction Performance
semts-qv:PointPredictionPerformance.def: Performance of point-valued predictions or forecasts.

semts-qv:ExplanationQuality.label: Explanation Quality
semts-qv:ExplanationQuality.def: A measure of the usefulness or faithfulness of an explanation.

semts-qv:PredictivePerformance.label: Predictive Performance
semts-qv:PredictivePerformance.def: A measure of the performance of predictive or inferential knowledge.

semts-qv:ProbabilisticPredictionPerforma.label: Probabilistic Prediction Performance
semts-qv:ProbabilisticPredictionPerforma.def: Performance of probabilistic forecasts or predictive distributions.

semts-qv:ClassificationPerformance.label: Classification Performance
semts-qv:ClassificationPerformance.def: Performance of class or event-category predictions.

semts-qv:IntrinsicQuality.label: Intrinsic Quality
semts-qv:IntrinsicQuality.def: Quality assessed from the internal content or logical form of the knowledge.

semts-qv:RelationalMeasure.label: Relational Measure
semts-qv:RelationalMeasure.def: A measure comparing two or more data, segment, or knowledge entities.

semts-qv:ContextualQuality.label: Contextual Quality
semts-qv:ContextualQuality.def: Quality assessed relative to a use case, segment context, task, or scenario.

semts-qv:PredictionError.label: Prediction Error
semts-qv:PredictionError.def: Magnitude or rate of disagreement between predicted and observed values.

semts-qv:EpistemicQuality.label: Epistemic Quality
semts-qv:EpistemicQuality.def: Quality concerning belief strength, uncertainty, evidence, and trustworthiness.

semts-qv:QualityMeasure.label: Knowledge Quality Measure
semts-qv:QualityMeasure.def: A criterion or metric used to characterize the quality, fitness, confidence, or comparison of a SemTS knowledge item.
